description: Create the new all-AWS CI/CD stack and buildspecs. Terraform stack 6_deploy/infra/codepipeline/ (CodeCommit repo, V2 CodePipeline, two CodeBuild projects + their log groups, artifact S3 bucket, SNS approval topic, CodeBuild + CodePipeline IAM roles with SPBC-Deploy-Permissions ported VERBATIM from 6_deploy/infra/github-oidc/main.tf), the two buildspecs under 6_deploy/codepipeline/ mapping deploy.yml's steps onto the existing scripts under toggle env vars, and the operator README. Purely additive — does not touch GitHub or ci_checks.sh, so the tree stays buildable. Independent of FEAT-002/003 in content but MUST land first because they depend on this stack existing.
steps: ALWAYS `export PATH="$HOME/.spbc-deploy/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"` before any terraform command (gets terraform 1.16.6). Use absolute paths rooted at the worktree.

Create 6_deploy/infra/codepipeline/versions.tf: terraform required_version >= 1.10.0; backend "s3" { bucket="spbc-tfstate-eu-central-1", key="prod/codepipeline.tfstate", region="eu-central-1", encrypt=true, use_lockfile=true }; required_providers only aws = {source="hashicorp/aws", version="~> 5.100"} (NO tls provider); provider "aws" { region=var.aws_region, default_tags { Project="SpecialtyBakeriesCafe", Component="CodePipelineDeploy", Environment=var.environment, ManagedBy="Terraform" } }. Model on 6_deploy/infra/github-oidc/versions.tf minus the tls provider.

Create 6_deploy/infra/codepipeline/variables.tf with every variable from the design variables table: aws_region("eu-central-1"), environment("production"), repository_name("spbc-pastry-concierge"), branch_name("main"), codebuild_role_name("SPBC-CodeBuild-Deploy"), codepipeline_role_name("SPBC-CodePipeline-Deploy"), deploy_project_name("spbc-deploy"), ci_project_name("spbc-ci"), execution_role_name_patterns (list(string) with the EXACT 7-entry default from github-oidc/variables.tf: ["SPBC-*","SPBC_*","spbc-*","Cognito_*","AmazonBedrockExecutionRoleForKnowledgeBase_*","AmazonBedrockAgentCore*","pastrycafe-*"]), artifact_bucket_name(""), codebuild_image("aws/codebuild/amazonlinux2-x86_64-standard:5.0"), codebuild_compute_type("BUILD_GENERAL1_MEDIUM"), log_retention_days(30), enable_manual_approval(true), approval_email(""), toggle_provision_backends(false), toggle_setup_knowledge_bases(false), toggle_deploy_agent(true), toggle_deploy_eks(false), toggle_smoke(false), cognito_admin_username(""), cognito_admin_password_secret_id(""), smoke_test_url("").

Create 6_deploy/infra/codepipeline/iam.tf: data "aws_caller_identity" "current" and data "aws_partition" "current"; locals account_id, partition, role_arns = [for p in var.execution_role_name_patterns : "arn:${local.partition}:iam::${local.account_id}:role/${p}"], pass_role_arns = [for a in local.role_arns : a if !can(regex("/aws-service-role/", a))], artifact_bucket_name = var.artifact_bucket_name != "" ? var.artifact_bucket_name : "spbc-pipeline-artifacts-${local.account_id}-${var.aws_region}". Define aws_iam_role.codebuild_deploy (name=var.codebuild_role_name, assume-role trust codebuild.amazonaws.com) and aws_iam_role.codepipeline (name=var.codepipeline_role_name, trust codepipeline.amazonaws.com).

In iam.tf add aws_iam_role_policy "SPBC-Deploy-Permissions" on the codebuild role, backed by a data.aws_iam_policy_document that is a VERBATIM copy of data.aws_iam_policy_document.permissions in 6_deploy/infra/github-oidc/main.tf: 14 statements with identical sids/actions/resources: Identity, BedrockModelsKnowledgeBasesGuardrails (full enumerated bedrock list), AgentCoreRuntime(bedrock-agentcore:*), VectorStore(aoss:*), StoresDatabase(rds:*,rds-data:*), NetworkForTheDatabase(ec2:*), PromotionsApiAndTools(lambda:*,apigateway:*,execute-api:Invoke), Secrets(secretsmanager:*), DataStores(dynamodb:*,s3:*), FrontendAndAuth(cognito-idp:*,cognito-identity:*,amplify:*), ContainersAndClusters(ecr:*,eks:*,codebuild:*,cloudformation:*), Observability(logs:*,cloudwatch:*,xray:*,ssm:GetParameter/GetParameters/PutParameter/DescribeParameters), ManageOnlyThisProjectsRoles(iam create/delete/put/delete/attach/detach role policy + UpdateAssumeRolePolicy+TagRole+CreateServiceLinkedRole on local.role_arns), PassOnlyThisProjectsRoles(iam:PassRole on local.pass_role_arns). Do NOT port the trust/OIDC doc or aws_iam_openid_connect_provider.

In iam.tf add two orchestration policies (new, NOT in the ported doc): aws_iam_role_policy "SPBC-CodeBuild-Logs-Artifacts" on the codebuild role (logs:CreateLogStream+PutLogEvents scoped to the two log-group ARNs arn:${partition}:logs:${region}:${account}:log-group:/aws/codebuild/spbc-deploy:* and .../spbc-ci:* ; s3 Get/Put/List on the artifact bucket arn and its /*), and aws_iam_role_policy "SPBC-CodePipeline-Permissions" on the pipeline role (codecommit GetBranch/GetCommit/UploadArchive/GetUploadArchiveStatus/CancelUploadArchive on the repo arn; codebuild StartBuild/BatchGetBuilds on the two project arns; s3 Get/Put/List on the artifact bucket; sns:Publish on the approvals topic). Use data.aws_iam_policy_document for each.

Create 6_deploy/infra/codepipeline/codecommit.tf: aws_codecommit_repository.this (repository_name=var.repository_name, default_branch="main"); aws_s3_bucket.artifacts (bucket=local.artifact_bucket_name) + aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration (AES256) + aws_s3_bucket_versioning (Enabled) + aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block (all four true) + aws_s3_bucket_lifecycle_configuration (expire current versions after 30 days); aws_sns_topic.approvals (name "spbc-pipeline-approvals"); count-guarded aws_sns_topic_subscription (count = var.approval_email != "" ? 1 : 0, protocol "email", endpoint var.approval_email).

Create 6_deploy/infra/codepipeline/codebuild.tf: two aws_cloudwatch_log_group ("/aws/codebuild/spbc-deploy", "/aws/codebuild/spbc-ci", retention_in_days=var.log_retention_days) — non-optional. aws_codebuild_project.deploy (name=var.deploy_project_name, service_role=aws_iam_role.codebuild_deploy.arn, source{type="CODEPIPELINE",buildspec="6_deploy/codepipeline/buildspec-deploy.yml"}, artifacts{type="CODEPIPELINE"}, environment{type="LINUX_CONTAINER",image=var.codebuild_image,compute_type=var.codebuild_compute_type,privileged_mode=false,image_pull_credentials_type="CODEBUILD", environment_variable blocks for the five toggles + COGNITO_ADMIN_USERNAME + COGNITO_ADMIN_PASSWORD_SECRET_ID + SMOKE_TEST_URL as PLAINTEXT}, logs_config{cloudwatch_logs{group_name="/aws/codebuild/spbc-deploy"}}, build_timeout=120). aws_codebuild_project.ci (name=var.ci_project_name, same service_role, buildspec "6_deploy/codepipeline/buildspec-ci.yml", same image/compute, privileged_mode=false, logs at "/aws/codebuild/spbc-ci").

Create 6_deploy/infra/codepipeline/codepipeline.tf: aws_codepipeline.this (name=var.repository_name, pipeline_type="V2", role_arn=aws_iam_role.codepipeline.arn, artifact_store{location=aws_s3_bucket.artifacts.bucket,type="S3"}). Stages in order: Source (CodeCommit; configuration RepositoryName=var.repository_name, BranchName=var.branch_name, PollForSourceChanges="false"; output_artifacts=["source_output"]); Validate (CodeBuild; ProjectName=var.ci_project_name; input_artifacts=["source_output"]); Approve (ONLY when var.enable_manual_approval — use a dynamic stage or guarded construct; category=Approval, provider=Manual, configuration NotificationArn=aws_sns_topic.approvals.arn); Deploy (CodeBuild; ProjectName=var.deploy_project_name; input_artifacts=["source_output"]; action configuration EnvironmentVariables JSON overriding the toggles from pipeline-level variables). Add pipeline-level variable blocks for the five toggles with their var defaults.

Create 6_deploy/infra/codepipeline/outputs.tf: codecommit_repository_name, codecommit_clone_url_http, codecommit_clone_url_grc = "codecommit::${var.aws_region}://${var.repository_name}", pipeline_name, codebuild_deploy_role_arn, codepipeline_role_arn, artifact_bucket = local.artifact_bucket_name, approvals_topic_arn.

Create 6_deploy/infra/codepipeline/terraform.tfvars.example (mirror github-oidc's: aws_region, environment, repository_name, optional cognito_admin_* / smoke_test_url, approval_email, note execution_role_name_patterns rarely needs overriding) and 6_deploy/infra/codepipeline/.gitignore (identical to github-oidc/.gitignore: .terraform/, .terraform.lock.hcl, terraform.tfvars, *.tfstate, *.tfstate.*, crash.log).

Create 6_deploy/codepipeline/buildspec-ci.yml (version 0.2): install phase downloads+unzips pinned Terraform 1.16.6 from releases.hashicorp.com to /usr/local/bin (NOT the image's bundled terraform) and runs `pip install -r requirements.txt`; build phase runs `make ci`.

Create 6_deploy/codepipeline/buildspec-deploy.yml (version 0.2) mapping deploy.yml's steps. install phase: python3.11 + `pip install -r requirements.txt`; `pip install -r 6_deploy/agents/requirements-deploy.txt`; download+unzip pinned Terraform 1.16.6 to /usr/local/bin; `pip install uv`. Keep ALL deploy steps in ONE build phase (single shell so sourced env + IMAGE_TAG persist). Ordered gated blocks: (1) always `aws sts get-caller-identity`; (2) always `export IMAGE_TAG=${CODEBUILD_RESOLVED_SOURCE_VERSION:0:12}`; (3) if provision_backends: AUTO_APPROVE=1 bash 6_deploy/scripts/agentcore_backends.sh apply, then seed, then check; (4) always `source setup_env.sh`; (5) if setup_knowledge_bases: source ~/environment/env.sh, bash 3_proof_of_concept/knowledge_bases/bootstrap_vector_store.sh, bash 3_proof_of_concept/knowledge_bases/setup_knowledge_bases.sh, re-source setup_env.sh; (6) if deploy_agent (ALONE, no push override): source ~/environment/env.sh, build args=(--force --non-interactive) + --skip-user when COGNITO_ADMIN_USERNAME or COGNITO_ADMIN_PASSWORD_SECRET_ID empty, bash 6_deploy/scripts/post_deploy.sh "${args[@]}"; (7) if deploy_agent: source ~/environment/env.sh, ./deploy_agentcore.sh step9-test-runtime; (8) if deploy_eks: source ~/environment/env.sh, bash 6_deploy/scripts/build_webapp_image.sh, terraform -chdir=6_deploy/infra/terraform init -input=false, export ECR_REPOSITORY_URL=$(terraform -chdir=6_deploy/infra/terraform output -raw ecr_repository_url), aws eks update-kubeconfig --region "$AWS_REGION" --name "${EKS_CLUSTER_NAME:-pastrycafe-prod}", bash 6_deploy/scripts/deploy_blue_green.sh (call the two scripts DIRECTLY, NOT make deploy); (9) if smoke AND SMOKE_TEST_URL != "": SMOKE_TEST_URL=... bash 6_deploy/scripts/smoke_test.sh.

Create 6_deploy/infra/codepipeline/README.md (operator doc) per the design's operator-doc section: (1) apply order/bootstrap — state bucket must exist first; RECOMMEND `aws s3api create-bucket --bucket spbc-tfstate-eu-central-1 --region eu-central-1 --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=eu-central-1` then versioning+encryption; document the `make backend-setup` alternative with real caveats (CIDR not 'any value'; auto-detects outbound IP and errors on failure; refuses 0.0.0.0/0 without --allow-open; rewrites 6_deploy/infra/terraform/terraform.tfvars; run as EKS_PUBLIC_ACCESS_CIDRS=<cidr/32> make backend-setup); then terraform -chdir=6_deploy/infra/codepipeline init + apply; -backend-config="bucket=<name>"/TF_STATE_BUCKET state override + separate artifact_bucket_name knob. (2) push to CodeCommit via git-remote-codecommit (pip install git-remote-codecommit; git remote add codecommit codecommit::eu-central-1://spbc-pastry-concierge; git push codecommit main) or HTTPS clone URL + AWS CLI credential helper. (3) trigger/approve — push to main starts pipeline; Validate runs make ci; Approve pauses + notifies spbc-pipeline-approvals (console or aws codepipeline put-approval-result). (4) toggle env vars — five toggles, only deploy_agent=true by default; COGNITO_ADMIN_* empty => --skip-user; smoke runs only when toggle_smoke AND SMOKE_TEST_URL set. (5) security note — broad service actions, scoped IAM management/PassRole on SPBC-* patterns, role assumed by CodeBuild directly (no OIDC), carried-forward self/sibling role-modify posture.

Do NOT run terraform apply, aws create-repository, or any mutating AWS call. Do NOT commit .terraform/ or .terraform.lock.hcl. After verifying, set this FEAT's status to completed, record in findings any file paths or decisions FEAT-002/003 need (e.g. confirmed stack dir path, confirmed that the IAM port matches), then git add the new files and commit locally on the worktree branch (do not push).

Both 6_deploy/codepipeline/buildspec-ci.yml and buildspec-deploy.yml parse as valid YAML and have top-level `version` and `phases` keys (verify via python yaml; pyyaml is not preinstalled so install into an ephemeral env and clean up).

The ported SPBC-Deploy-Permissions document in iam.tf is statement-for-statement identical (14 sids, same actions, same scoped resources) to data.aws_iam_policy_document.permissions in 6_deploy/infra/github-oidc/main.tf — no added, removed, or loosened statements.

All of versions.tf, variables.tf, iam.tf, codecommit.tf, codebuild.tf, codepipeline.tf, outputs.tf, terraform.tfvars.example, .gitignore, README.md exist under 6_deploy/infra/codepipeline/, and buildspec-ci.yml + buildspec-deploy.yml exist under 6_deploy/codepipeline/.
No terraform apply / AWS create/mutate call was made; no .terraform/ or .terraform.lock.hcl committed.
